blind_target.title: A sequence variant in ZFHX3 on 16q22 associates with atrial fibrillation and ischemic stroke
blind_target.evidence_quote: We aimed to replicate the associations of eight loci with IS and/or its subtypes as previously reported in an independent set of patients with IS drawn from a Dutch cohort.
blind_target.outcome_quote: We also replicated 16q22 (ZFHX3) as a risk locus for CE (OR = 1.62 for the T allele; 95% CI, 1.26–2.07, p = 0.0014) and found this locus significantly associated with overall IS (OR = 1.28 for the T allele; 95% CI, 1.12–1.47, p = 0.002) (Table 1).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: ZFHX3 associations with overall IS and CE replicated, as originally reported in reference 10. Identification follows Table 1 numbered reference mapping, corroborated by the discussion.

corrected_value.title: A sequence variant in ZFHX3 on 16q22 associates with atrial fibrillation and ischemic stroke

prior_decision.quote: We also replicated 16q22 (ZFHX3) as a risk locus for CE (OR = 1.62 for the T allele; 95% CI, 1.26–2.07, p = 0.0014) and found this locus significantly associated with overall IS (OR = 1.28 for the T allele; 95% CI, 1.12–1.47, p = 0.002) (Table 1).
prior_decision.reason: Ref. 10 (Gudbjartsson et al. 2009) is an omitted target explicitly re-tested in Table 1 for the 16q22 (ZFHX3) rs7193343 associations with overall IS and CE stroke, both of which were confirmed.

luna_triage.reason: The Results explicitly report replicating the 16q22 (ZFHX3) association for cardioembolic stroke and overall ischemic stroke.
